# ProLine Roofing

> ProLine Roofing is a licensed and insured roofing contractor based in Staten Island, NY, providing residential and commercial roof repair, roof replacement, and gutter services. Also serving Brooklyn, NY and northern/central New Jersey (Clifton, Elizabeth, Freehold, Jersey City, Newark, and Old Bridge).

## Services

- [Residential Roofing](https://www.proline-roofing.com/services/residential-roofing/): Asphalt shingle, metal, tile, and cedar shake roofing, plus inspections and maintenance.
- [Commercial Roofing](https://www.proline-roofing.com/services/commercial-roofing/): Flat roofing, commercial metal roofing, roof inspections, and maintenance contracts.
- [Roof Repair](https://www.proline-roofing.com/services/roof-repair/): Roof leak repair, storm damage repair, skylight repair, and gutter repair.
- [Roof Replacement](https://www.proline-roofing.com/services/roof-replacement/): Residential and commercial roof replacement.
- [Gutter Services](https://www.proline-roofing.com/services/gutter-services/): Gutter cleaning, gutter guards, and gutter installation.

## Locations

- [Staten Island, NY](https://www.proline-roofing.com/locations/staten-island-ny/roof-repair/): Primary market and company headquarters.
- [Brooklyn, NY](https://www.proline-roofing.com/locations/brooklyn-ny/)
- [New Jersey (overview)](https://www.proline-roofing.com/locations/new-jersey/): Clifton, Elizabeth, Freehold, Jersey City, Newark, and Old Bridge.
